stories.title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
stories.reason: DeepSeek's own production inference framework (DeepInfer) open-sourced under Apache-2.0: speculative decoding (DSpark), MoE expert-parallel scheduling, batch-invariant/deterministic sampling, runnable code. Directly on the always-surface inference-serving topic; #1 on HN at 2143 points so already saturated, surface briefly as headline.
key_facts: Apache-2.0, ~15k GitHub stars, runnable via build.sh + examples/offline_inference.py
Serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs
DSpark speculative decoding, default max draft length 5
Attention data-parallel + balanced context-parallel + MoE expert-parallel (EPLB)
Batch-invariant inference and deterministic sampling (NVIDIA only); no bundled KV-cache service
2143 HN points, 837 comments

stories.title: EMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
stories.reason: Private keys for 8 eMudhra intermediate CA certs were recoverable from the public certs (bad keygen since April 2025); chains to roots trusted by every major browser. Pure-cyber with no AI angle, but large enough (internet-trust-infra scale) to be a headline on its own.
key_facts: 8 eMudhra intermediate CA certs compromised; flaw traced to incorrect key generation at issuance (April 2025)
Firefox/Chrome blocked certs Oct 17, Apple Oct 19, Microsoft Oct 20 via OneCRL/CRLite/CRLSets
No CT log entries found for the intermediates during the window, so CT-enforcing browsers likely weren't exploited; non-CT clients' exposure unknown
Downstream fixes shipped/pending for Ubuntu, Debian, Arch, Fedora, Alpine, NSS, curl, Go, Python certifi, Electron; FreeBSD/Node.js/Bun pending

stories.title: Hackers Use Autonomous AI Agents to Breach Company Websites, Target Over 1,200 Sites
stories.reason: Reuters-sourced, concrete AI-agent attack campaign: a criminal pointed the open-source pentest tool Cairn at 1,200+ sites, breaching 100+ companies (Deere, SharkNinja, Cummins) with ~10% success and ~$50/successful hack in token cost. This is exactly the agent/MCP-attack-chain-with-evidence case Mine always wants surfaced.
key_facts: Open-source pentest tool Cairn (github.com/oritera/Cairn) repurposed; operator instructions were under 100 Chinese characters
1,200+ sites targeted, 100+ companies reached; Deere, SharkNinja, Cummins named, two smaller firms confirmed compromised
~10% success rate (NorForge), ~23h average time-to-breach, ~$5/task, ~$50 in tokens per successful hack, ~$5,000 total campaign spend
Researcher Snorre Fagerland (NorForge) found ~24 exposed Cairn control panels; Trufflehog found hundreds of leaked secrets, 11% still valid
A worker was labeled claudecode_deepseek-v4.1-flash, suggesting DeepSeek V4.1 Flash driven via Claude Code, unconfirmed by Reuters

stories.title: Upcoming Critical PHP Security Release
stories.reason: Official php.net security announcement: two critical RCEs, CVSS v4.0 9.2 each, fix due 21 Oct 14:00 UTC, possibly earlier if exploited. Pure-cyber with no AI angle but huge blast radius (affects essentially all PHP deployments) — large enough to earn a headline slot; no CVE numbers or affected-version list given yet.
key_facts: Two critical vulns, CVSS v4.0 9.2 each, announced by Jakub Zelenka
Fix scheduled Wed 21 Oct 2026 14:00 UTC, may ship earlier if details leak or exploitation is observed
No CVE IDs or affected-version list published yet

stories.title: Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
stories.reason: Rigorous, wet-lab-validated Claude-designed protein binders against 5 scorpion neurotoxins: 211 designs tested across two independent labs, 17 confirmed hits (nanomolar KD on the best), full dataset released on Hugging Face. Strong pure-AI science result with real validation, not just a model-release announcement.
key_facts: Claude generated 318,484 candidate designs, co-folded 553k design-toxin pairs, selected 211 for wet-lab testing over a ~64h campaign (~10k GPU-hours)
17 of 211 confirmed binders (validated independently at Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience via SPR, KD <=1uM, no off-target signal)
Top Cn2 binders hit single-digit nanomolar KD and appear to share an epitope with an antibody already shown to neutralize Cn2 in mice
No cell/animal neutralization tested yet -- not an antivenom claim; all 211 designs + data released on Hugging Face

stories.title: Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model
stories.reason: A DeepSeek-harness plugin claiming free unlimited frontier-model access gates access behind a GitHub star (inflating its 31k-star count), hides provider credentials via obfuscation specifically designed to evade scanners, and impersonates official client fingerprints to dodge free-tier limits; README itself admits a compromised maintainer key could push malicious code to every user. Concrete, verifiable AI-tool supply-chain risk with low saturation (not covered elsewhere).
key_facts: Gates the 'EAC' free channel behind requiring a GitHub star, which the README's own star count (31k) cannot be taken as organic
Credentials stored obfuscated specifically so 'ciphertext is noise to search engines and string scanners' per its own README
Documents 'fingerprint decoy' tooling that spoofs official client identifiers (x-opencode-* headers) to evade free-tier rate limiting
Warns that unofficial npm copies of the same package have been tampered with (modified index.js/client.js)
Single maintainer signing key controls remote auto-update for all installs

stories.title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
stories.reason: Cloudflare's new 'System One' extraction-model class (Clairic): single-pass, no reasoning tokens, available now in Workers AI preview with concrete pipeline numbers (3.2x latency, ~49% cost reduction vs. an LLM doing the same steps). Fits Mine's interest in how models are served, not just trained; numbers are vendor case studies, not standardized benchmarks.
key_facts: Single-pass extraction model distinct from 'decision' models (Jev/Clef); returns values with null + p_null + confidence when absent
Claims pipeline (Clairic+Clef feeding GLM-5.3) cut latency 61.7s->19.3s (3.2x) and cost/million claims $11,740->$6,032 (~49%) vs. GLM-5.3 doing every step
21-day TSA checkpoint forecast off by 3.3% average, 17/21 actuals inside the 80% interval
Available now in Workers AI preview (@cf/cloudflare/clairic); not yet open-weight, Cloudflare says weights coming 'soon'

stories.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs
stories.reason: Google open-sourced a native PyTorch/XLA backend for TPUs (Apache-2.0, runnable via pip install torch_tpu). Directly on the inference/training-serving infra topic, but it's an early-stage project (~400 stars, v0.2.0, deps still 'TBD' in its own README) with no performance numbers given.
key_facts: google-pytorch/torch_tpu, Apache-2.0, pip install torch_tpu==0.2.0, Python 3.11+
Custom ATen kernels, XLA compilation cache, data/tensor-parallel distributed training, torch.compile() integration
Early-stage: ~400 stars/20 forks, 48 open issues, README's own Dependencies section marked 'TBD'
No throughput/latency numbers published
